atmosphere. This structural failure led to the uncontrolled release of a flammable gas mixture directly onto the deck.

in the accommodation module; however, a continuous flammable gas cloud was extending laterally across the full 
width of the platform, spanning from one side to the other. As a result, access to the muster location necessarily

release continued for nearly one hour, until the tanks were fully vented and pressure equalized with the atmosphere.

halted, and personnel were exposed to significant risk due to the prolonged presence of a flammable atmosphere 
across the installation.
